style: Use case: historical-scene. Asset: ONE new mission portrait for a Europa Universalis IV Teutonic Crusader extension. Style: restrained historical oil-painted EU4 mission illustration, broad painterly shapes, subdued ochre, ivory, brown and steel blue, natural light, brush texture, subtle dark edge shading, grounded late-medieval to early-modern costume and buildings. One dominant silhouette and simple background, readable when reduced to 59x63 pixels. Full-bleed nearly square portrait, composition safe within center 85 percent. No frame, no UI, no letters, no numbers, no readable text, no watermark, no fantasy glow, no modern objects. Do not depict red crusader crosses: Order heraldry is a plain BLACK cross on ivory. subjects.I01: Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE painted mission icon for a Europa Universalis IV Teutonic Order mod, mission 'Muster Houses'. Subject: a late-medieval Prussian red-brick mustering house and a single helmeted sergeant in an ivory surcoat bearing a simple black cross, spear upright, recruits suggested behind. EU4 mission-art visual language: miniature historical oil painting, broad readable shapes, subdued ochre/ivory/steel blue, brush texture, natural daylight, dark edge shading, restrained contrast, grounded fifteenth-century equipment. Tight centered composition readable at only 59 by 63 pixels. Building and sergeant should dominate, no tiny narrative clutter. Full-bleed nearly square portrait artwork, no UI border, no lettering, no logos, no text, no watermark, no fantasy armor or glowing magic. This is new extension art; do not alter any original game asset.
